mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly identifies the establishment year, headquarters and Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)?
options: Established in 1945; headquartered in Rome; Director-General: Qu Dongyu
Established in 1950; headquartered in Geneva; Director-General: Qu Dongyu
Established in 1945; headquartered in Geneva; Director-General: Qu Dongyu
Established in 1950; headquartered in Rome; Director-General: Qu Dongyu
mcqs.explanation: The FAO was established in 1945, is headquartered in Rome, and is headed by Director-General Qu Dongyu. The tempting alternative is Geneva, but Geneva is associated with the UNHCR, not the FAO.
